translations.onboarding.welcome_body: Take a quick look at colour control, scenes, sync, automations, connection and diagnostics. The tour animates only this interface — it never sends a command to your lights.
translations.onboarding.welcome_note: A short visual tour · no controller required
translations.onboarding.tour_color_body: Tune colour and brightness with immediate visual feedback. The movement you see now is only a preview.
translations.onboarding.tour_scenes_body: Scenes remember colour, brightness and effects, while ready-made modes change the atmosphere in one click.
translations.onboarding.tour_sync_title: Bring the screen into the room
translations.onboarding.tour_sync_body: The live preview shows the screen colour and the result sent to the strip. Music separately reacts to PC audio or a microphone.
translations.onboarding.tour_automation_title: Let the light react for you
translations.onboarding.tour_automation_body: Rules can respond to time, an active app, inactivity or a connected strip — without a long chain of actions.
translations.onboarding.tour_device_body: Find, connect, rename and safely inspect a controller here.
translations.onboarding.tour_status_body: The lower-left status always shows whether the strip is connected. Watch it move through all three states.
translations.onboarding.tour_diagnostics_title: Answers when something does not connect
translations.onboarding.tour_diagnostics_body: Diagnostics and the BLE scan report collect the technical facts needed to troubleshoot or add a new controller.

translations.about.title: LumaBLE
translations.about.supported_intro: LumaBLE works with these Bluetooth LED controller families. Unknown devices can still be probed and reported to add support:
translations.about.privacy_text: LumaBLE does not send data automatically. Diagnostics are created only when you copy or export them. The report contains app, OS and BLE controller details for troubleshooting; it does not include profiles, personal files or private folders.
translations.about.components_text:
Interface: PySide6 / Qt
Bluetooth: bleak
Screen capture: mss
Audio: soundcard
Signal processing: numpy
Icons: Lucide Icons (ISC License)
Data folders: platformdirs
Theme detection: darkdetect
